records.original_sql:
COPY (SELECT range AS n FROM range(50, 100))
    TO '${VGI_TEST_BRANCH_DIR}/vgi_hetero_branch.parquet' (FORMAT 'parquet');
records.replacement_sql:
COPY (SELECT value AS n FROM range(50, 100))
    TO '${VGI_TEST_BRANCH_DIR}/vgi_hetero_branch.parquet' STORED AS PARQUET;
records.reason: DataFusion spells the same Parquet COPY with STORED AS PARQUET and names its range output value.
